distanceNote: Distances are approximate mileages printed on CAB’s map. Walking times assume 2–3 mph, before stops.
mapNote: Illustrated trail guide, not GPS navigation. CAB links this October 2025 map as its existing-trail map. Route names below are descriptive guide labels; current closures are not tracked here. School and Prospect Park labels are updated from the current operator sources below.

routes.name: A lap around Prospect
routes.description: A short park loop to pair with the playground or a little time on the lawn.
routes.start: The loop inside Prospect Park, off Monte Vista Circle
routes.finish: Return to your starting point in the park
steps: Find the loop around the central park lawn, marked 0.38 mi on the trail map.
Follow the same loop back to where you started. The paths leaving the park are separate routes.
routes.sourceScope: The existing-trail loop and its 0.38-mi label come from the CAB map. Its old park-construction label is superseded by CAB’s current Prospect Park facility listing; it is not used as current park status.
routes.geometryMethod: Manual visual trace of the labelled inner loop in the official map image; schematic display only.

routes.name: Providence’s west greenway
routes.description: Follow the greenway around the western edge of Providence, from Titan Road down to the Xcel corridor.
routes.start: Titan Road’s trail junction on the western edge of Providence
steps: Start where the dashed trail leaves Titan Road and heads south along the western edge of Providence.
Follow the 0.69-mi section around the neighborhood’s west side to the greenway bend.
Continue on the adjoining 0.35-mi section to the Xcel corridor junction. Turn back for an approximately 2.08-mi out-and-back.
routes.sourceScope: Two adjoining Existing Trail sections labelled 0.69 mi and 0.35 mi on CAB’s map. Total is their sum. Nearby parks are separate destinations, not promised entrances on this walk.
routes.geometryMethod: Manual visual trace of two labelled adjoining alignments in the official map image; schematic display only.

routes.name: Titan Road to the Overlook
routes.description: The eastern Providence trail link beside the open space, ending at the Overlook trail junction.
routes.start: Titan Road’s eastern Providence trail junction
routes.finish: The trail junction beside the Overlook Clubhouse
steps: Find the trail turning south from Titan Road beside the eastern open space.
Follow the curved section marked 0.37 mi to the junction beside the Overlook. The clubhouse and pool have their own access rules.
Retrace the same section for an approximately 0.74-mi out-and-back.
routes.sourceScope: The eastern curved Existing Trail section is labelled 0.37 mi on CAB’s map. Its endpoint is the trail junction, not a verified clubhouse entrance.
routes.geometryMethod: Manual visual trace of the labelled eastern alignment in the official map image; schematic display only.
